# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 29 Oct 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Private Home Prices & Sales — Q3 2026 URA Data

- **Private home prices rose 1.4% in Q3 2026, the fastest pace in nearly two years** - URA flash data released 23 October shows prices accelerated from 0.5% in Q2, even as new launches were fewer during the quarter. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/singapore-private-home-prices-rise-1-4-in-q3-2026-amid-a-quieter-new-launch-calendar/)

- **Price gains came alongside a 16.3% drop in sales to 5,146 units — the lowest this year** - Projects such as Lentor Gardens Residences and higher land costs were cited as contributors to the price increase, while transaction volumes fell to their lowest point in 2026. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/private-home-prices-rose-fastest-pace/)

- **Condo resale volumes recovered in September 2026, with prices edging up** - An estimated 1,093 units changed hands in September, up 10.8% month-on-month, with the Core Central Region driving much of the price improvement. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-resale-activity-recovers-as-prices-continue-to-rise-in-september-2026/)

## HDB Resale Market

- **HDB resale transactions hit a two-year high in Q3 2026, but prices slipped for a third straight quarter** - More flats changed hands than in any quarter since 2024, yet resale prices continued a run of consecutive quarterly declines. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/hdb-resale-transactions-hit-a-two-year-high-in-q3-2026-as-prices-continue-to-decline/)

## New Land Supply — GLS Reserve List

- **Two GLS Reserve List sites at Chuan Grove and the former Raffles Town Club could add 1,180 private homes** - URA released both sites under the 2H2026 GLS Reserve List; the Chuan Grove site is sized for around 930 homes, with the Plymouth Avenue/Dunearn Road site (former Raffles Town Club) making up the remainder. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/gls-reserve-list-site-chuan-grove-former-raffles-town-club-1180-homes/)

- **A developer paid 12% less per square foot for a Marina South GLS site than the adjacent plot fetched** - EL Development won the Marina Gardens Lane site at $1,243 psf ppr, compared with the higher price Kingsford paid for the neighbouring One Marina Gardens site. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/owners-one-marina-gardens-may-feel/)
